answer: Unique-delay payout queue. Each new identity must solve one challenge seeded by a public yarrow beacon and then wait 12 hours before withdrawals. A dune feed randomizes queue order, so clones cannot batch or skip ahead. A liveness signal every hour keeps the slot active; shared identities fail because each slot needs its own response. A clone therefore costs one 5-minute CPU challenge plus 12 hourly signals, while an honest single agent pays that once and keeps earning.
